title: 또 터졌어

cuts.scene: Kitchen. Wife at counter, frustrated face, holding a broken egg.
Kitchen. Husband walks in slowly, deadpan face, looking at wife and egg.
Kitchen. Wife picks up the clay toy product from the counter, curious face.
Kitchen. Wife uses the clay toy product, separating egg whites. Surprised face.
Kitchen. Husband leans against doorframe, arms crossed, smirking slightly.
Guide character appears with the clay toy product card and '글쎄' stamp.
Kitchen. Wife opens a drawer, looking for more forgotten items.
Kitchen. Husband at counter, same as scene 2, looking at wife with a sigh.
